DocumentId.description: An open Document, as documents.list gives it.

SkillName.description: A skill's name, which is its folder's.

LineId.description: A Line's stable id: it survives edits, moves and undo, unlike its row.

Revision.description: Counts the Document's committed changes; a write names the revision it was prepared against.

Line.description: Times are milliseconds. In translation mode text is the original and translation the translated text.

generatedFrom.description: The karaoke Line a templater run generated this one from.

Style.description: An ASS v4+ Style. Text fields hold the field's ASS text; colours are &HAABBGGRR.

LineFields.description: Line fields to set; the others keep their values.

StyleFields.description: Style fields to set; name renames it. A new Style starts from Arial 48.

oneOf.description: After or before a Line; at the end without either.
Before a Line, or to the end with before null.
Changes the Style with that name, or adds it.
A null value removes the property.

file.description: The handle files.read and files.write take.

operations.name: documents.list
operations.summary: The open Documents, in tab order, with the protected reference last.

readOnly.description: A macro holds it, or it is the protected reference.

operations.name: documents.get
operations.summary: One Document's summary, Line and Style counts and its pending Line editor draft.

readOnly.description: A macro holds it, or it is the protected reference.

draftLine.description: The Line with uncommitted Line editor changes; a write commits them first.

operations.name: lines.list
operations.summary: Lines in Document order, a page at a time.

fields.description: Only these fields besides id and row; all of them when omitted.

operations.name: lines.get
operations.summary: Lines by id, in the order asked.

fields.description: Only these fields besides id and row; all of them when omitted.

operations.name: lines.find
operations.summary: Lines matching every criterion given: text or regex in one field, exact Style, Actor or Effect, Comment, and a time window.

regex.description: A regular expression, as Find and replace takes it.

in.description: Where text and regex look; text when omitted.

from.description: Lines ending after this time, in milliseconds.

to.description: Lines starting before this time, in milliseconds.

limit.description: 500 when omitted; total still counts every match.

fields.description: Only these fields besides id and row; all of them when omitted.

operations.name: styles.list
operations.summary: The Document's Styles, in order.

operations.name: info.list
operations.summary: The Document's Script Info properties, in order.

operations.name: selection.get
operations.summary: The selected Lines, in Document order, and the active Line.

operations.name: api.version
operations.summary: The API version: it grows by one with each release that adds to the API.

operations.name: commands.list
operations.summary: The commands of menus, toolbars and shortcuts, with their enabled state and keys.

query.description: A case-insensitive part of the command id or its name.

command.description: The stable command id, e.g. GLOBAL_SAVE_SUBS.

name.description: The English name the shortcut editor shows.

operations.name: panels.list
operations.summary: The workspace panels and whether each is open, floating or focused.

operations.name: settings.list
operations.summary: Settings with their type, scope, default and current value.

prefix.description: Only ids starting with it, e.g. grid.

operations.name: settings.get
operations.summary: The current values of the settings named.

operations.name: commands.run
operations.summary: Runs an enabled command as its menu item, toolbar button or shortcut would.

operations.name: panels.open
operations.summary: Opens a panel where the layout keeps it.

operations.name: panels.close
operations.summary: Closes a panel.

operations.name: panels.focus
operations.summary: Opens a panel if needed and gives it the keyboard focus.

operations.name: settings.set
operations.summary: Changes a setting; the value must have the setting's type.

operations.name: document.apply
operations.summary: Applies edits prepared against a revision as one undo step; a stale revision changes nothing.

revision.description: The revision the edits were prepared against.

name.description: A few words naming the change, as the user reads it in the review and in History after the caller's name.

edits.description: Applied in order; any refusal leaves the Document as it was.

changed.description: False when the edits changed nothing: no undo step was added.

operations.name: selection.set
operations.summary: Selects Lines and makes one active, as a click in the Grid would; never an undo step.

active.description: The first selected Line when omitted.

operations.name: video.info
operations.summary: Whether a video is open, its size and aspect ratio, the frame shown and the keyframes.

operations.name: video.frame_at_time
operations.summary: The video frame shown at a time.

operations.name: video.time_of_frame
operations.summary: The time a video frame starts, in milliseconds.

operations.name: video.frame
operations.summary: One video frame as BGRA pixels in base64, with every Line, one Line or none drawn on it, optionally cropped, scaled to fit maxEdge and maxPixels.

frame.description: Default: the frame shown, or with line the Line's first frame when it is not on the frame shown.

subtitles.description: Render the subtitles on it. Default true.

document.description: line's Document. Defaults to the active Document.

maxPixels.description: The most pixels the image may have. No limit when omitted.

data.description: width * 4 bytes per row, top row first, base64.

operations.name: video.ink_bounds
operations.summary: Where one Line's ink, or every Line's, lies on a video frame, in video pixels.

frame.description: Default: the frame shown, or with line the Line's first frame when it is not on the frame shown.

line.description: This Line alone. Every Line when omitted.

operations.name: video.colours
operations.summary: The colours of a video frame at points, as ASS &HBBGGRR&, each the mean of the square radius pixels around it.

subtitles.description: Sample with the subtitles drawn. Default false.

operations.name: video.keyframes
operations.summary: The keyframes from one time to another, each with its start time.

total.description: Every keyframe in the range; the first 500 are listed.

operations.name: audio.info
operations.summary: Whether audio is open and loaded, its duration and sample rate.

operations.name: audio.peaks
operations.summary: The lowest and highest 16-bit sample in each of `buckets` equal slices of a time range.

operations.name: files.list
operations.summary: The files the user granted this caller, with read or write access.

operations.name: files.read
operations.summary: A granted file's content, as UTF-8 text or base64; at most 16 MiB.

operations.name: files.write
operations.summary: Replaces a file granted for writing with new content.

operations.name: skills.list
operations.summary: The user's skills: each skill folder's name and its files, SKILL.md among them.

operations.name: skills.read
operations.summary: One file of a user's skill, as UTF-8 text; at most 256 KiB.

file.description: A path skills.list gives, such as SKILL.md or references/tags.md.

operations.name: translation.project
operations.summary: The Document's Honya project files: PROJECT.md, GLOSSARY.md, CHARACTERS.md and STYLE.md, those that exist. folder is null when the Document has no project folder.

operations.name: translation.project_write
operations.summary: Replaces one of the Document's Honya project files, keeping Honya's Markdown and honya:data format.

operations.name: nodes.catalogue
operations.summary: The node types the node-effect editor offers, with their ports and parameters.

operations.name: nodes.validate
operations.summary: Checks a node-effect graph; each problem names its node and port or field.

events.name: document.changed
events.summary: A Document's content changed: a commit, Undo or Redo.

events.name: selection.changed
events.summary: The selected or the active Line changed.

events.name: documents.changed
events.summary: A Document opened or closed, or another became active.

events.name: panel.changed
events.summary: A panel opened, closed, floated, docked or took the focus.

events.name: command.ran
events.summary: A command ran, from a menu, a key, the API or anywhere else.

ok.description: False when it was refused or failed.
